init_SequencePathProvider: create a SequencePathProvider instance from a dataset sequence root directory path
access_body_paths: access body file paths like xsens_processed and momentum_model via the body_paths attribute
access_recording_paths: access recording subfolder paths for head, wrists, and observer cameras via recording attributes
access_narration_paths: access narration text file paths like motion_narration and atomic_action via the narration_paths attribute
repr_SequencePathProvider: get a string representation of a SequencePathProvider showing all resolved paths
